leadText: The Pokémon School (Japanese: ポケモンスクール Pokémon School) is an -exclusive Pokémon academy in the Alola region. It first appeared in Alola to New Adventure! and is one of the main settings of Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon. The school is located on Melemele Island. In Alola, Kanto!, the school celebrated its 20th anniversary. Sometime after The Professors' New Adventure!, the school was converted to be the base for the Ultra Guardians, which was first put to use in A Mission of Ultra Urgency!.
plainText:
The Pokémon School (Japanese: ポケモンスクール Pokémon School) is an -exclusive Pokémon academy in the Alola region. It first appeared in Alola to New Adventure! and is one of the main settings of Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon. The school is located on Melemele Island. In Alola, Kanto!, the school celebrated its 20th anniversary. Sometime after The Professors' New Adventure!, the school was converted to be the base for the Ultra Guardians, which was first put to use in A Mission of Ultra Urgency!.

==In animation==
===Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon===
 
 
The Pokémon School first appeared in Alola to New Adventure!, where and were tasked by to deliver an to Samson Oak. After meeting and several of the students, Ash opted to remain in Alola and study.

The Pokémon School held an open house event during Alolan Open House!, where a number of the students' families turned up. Ash was tasked with giving a presentation in front of everyone.

The Pokémon School celebrated its 20th anniversary during Alola, Kanto!, which saw the class taking a field trip to Kanto.

An alternate version of the Pokémon School was shown in the Ultra Ruin in Battling the Beast Within! and Parallel Friendships!. It is currently the home of .

===Pokémon Journeys: The Series===
In That New Old Gang of Mine!, Ash and Goh attended a welcome party at the Pokémon School arranged by Mallow and the others. Goh later d and , but the battle was called off after Kiawe used .

In Paring Pokémon While Parrying!, Ash's classmates, Alolan Pokémon, , Samson Oak, Professor Kukui, , and Lei were all seen watching Ash's Masters Eight Tournament match against at the Pokémon School.
